nodes.summary: Monotonicity of correlations (a consequence of the second Griffiths inequality): for `h ≥ 0`, every spin correlation `⟨σ_A⟩_{β,h}` is nondecreasing in `β ≥ 0` (Griffiths, J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967)).
nodes.title: Monotonicity of correlations

nodes.summary: Ginibre's duplicated-variable change of variables `(σ, q) ↦ (σ, σ q)` as an equivalence.
nodes.title: Ginibre's duplicated-variable change of variables

nodes.summary: The involution `(σ, q) ↦ (σ, σ q)` of pairs of configurations.
nodes.title: Duplicated-variable involution on configuration pairs

nodes.summary: The energy observable `∑_{e ∈ E(G)} σ_x σ_y + h ∑_x σ_x`, the `β`-derivative of the log-weight.
nodes.title: Energy observable of the Ising model

nodes.summary: The Gibbs expectation `⟨f⟩_{E,J,h} = ∑_σ f(σ) w(σ) / Z`.
nodes.title: Gibbs expectation with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields

nodes.summary: The weight `ρ(S) = ζ(S) ∏_{e ∈ S} tanh J_e = (Z_{E∖S} / Z_E) ∏_{e ∈ S} sinh J_e`.
nodes.title: Edge-removal weight with hyperbolic sine factors

nodes.summary: The edge-removal ratio `ζ(S) = (Z_{E∖S} / Z_E) ∏_{e ∈ S} cosh J_e`.
nodes.title: Edge-removal ratio of partition functions

nodes.summary: For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph with `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, every spin correlation is nonnegative: `0 ≤ ⟨σ_A⟩`.
nodes.title: First Griffiths inequality (GKS I)

nodes.summary: The positivity kernel of the GKS inequalities: for nonnegative `c_i, d_i` and spin monomials `fac i`, `obs`, the configuration sum of `obs · ∏_i (c_i + d_i · fac_i)` is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the GKS positivity kernel

nodes.summary: Griffiths' second inequality for nonnegative couplings and fields: `⟨σ_A⟩⟨σ_B⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, "Correlations in Ising ferromagnets I", J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967) 478–483; J. Ginibre, "General formulation of Griffiths' inequalities", Comm. Math. Phys. 16 (1970) 310–328. See also `gks_second` (GKS2) for uniform couplings.
nodes.title: Griffiths' second inequality for inhomogeneous couplings

nodes.summary: For the ferromagnetic Ising model on a finite graph with `β ≥ 0` and `h ≥ 0`, spin correlations are positively correlated: `⟨σ_A⟩ ⟨σ_B⟩ ≤ ⟨σ_A σ_B⟩ = ⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩`.
nodes.title: Second Griffiths inequality (GKS II)

nodes.summary: Griffiths monotonicity: adding edges with nonnegative couplings increases every correlation `⟨σ_A⟩`. Reference: R. B. Griffiths, "Correlations in Ising ferromagnets I", J. Math. Phys. 8 (1967) 478–483.
nodes.title: Griffiths monotonicity of correlations in the edge set

nodes.summary: `f` is a spin monomial `∏_x σ_x^{m_x}` for some exponents `m`.
nodes.title: Being a spin monomial

nodes.summary: The finite-volume Ising expectation `⟨f⟩ = ∑_s P(s) f(s)` of an observable `f`.
nodes.title: Finite-volume Ising expectation

nodes.summary: The Boltzmann weight factorizes as a product over edges and vertices of `cosh + sinh · σ` terms.
nodes.title: Boltzmann weight as a product of cosh-plus-sinh factors

nodes.summary: The spin monomial `∏_x σ_x^{m_x}` with exponents `m : V → ℕ`.
nodes.title: Spin monomial with given exponents

nodes.summary: The spin value `±1` of a Boolean: `1` for `true`, `-1` for `false`. See also `CondensedMatter.IsingModel.spin` and `StatMech.Ising.spinB_eq_isingModelSpin`.
nodes.title: Spin value of a Boolean

nodes.summary: The spin product `σ_A = ∏_{x ∈ A} σ_x`.
nodes.title: Spin product over a vertex set

nodes.summary: The sum of a spin monomial over all configurations is nonnegative.
nodes.title: Configuration sum of a spin monomial is nonnegative

nodes.summary: The unnormalized second Griffiths inequality: `Z² (⟨σ_{A ∆ B}⟩ - ⟨σ_A⟩⟨σ_B⟩) ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: Unnormalized second Griffiths inequality

nodes.summary: The Boltzmann weight `exp(∑_{e ∈ E} J_e σ_e + ∑_x h_x σ_x)`.
nodes.title: Boltzmann weight with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields

nodes.summary: The pointwise product of two configurations: spin `σ_y σ'_y` at `y` (`true` when the spins agree).
nodes.title: Pointwise product of two configurations

nodes.summary: The partition function `∑_σ wJ E J h σ`.
nodes.title: Partition function with inhomogeneous couplings and site fields

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
